item.title: Pensions and Fertility
item.author: 1450169683@qq.com (滑翔闪)
item.description: Notes on the AER paper ‘Pensions and Fertility: Microeconomic Evidence’. It uses microdata to study the relationship between pensions and fertility. Expanding pension coverage lowers fertility.
